title: Con el mecánico
desc: Something is broken and you cannot name it
setting: The bike has been making a noise for a week. You are standing over it with a man who is waiting for you to explain.

steps.speaker: Mecánico
steps.en: Let us see, what is wrong with it?

options.es: Hace un ruido cuando voy despacio. No sé de dónde sale.
options.en: It makes a noise when I go slowly. I do not know where it comes from.
options.feedback: What it does, when it does it, and an honest gap. That is everything he needs.

options.en: It is making a strange noise.
options.feedback: A start. Without the when, he has to guess twice.

options.en: I think it is the engine.
options.feedback: Guessing at a part you cannot name sends him to the wrong place and costs you an hour.

options.es: Como hace una semana, después de la lluvia grande.
options.en: About a week ago, after the big rain.
options.feedback: You gave him a time and an event. Half of what he knows comes from what happened just before.
Vague. A week and a month send him looking in different places.

options.en: It has always been like that.
options.feedback: If that were true you would not be here. He will believe you and stop looking.

steps.speaker: Mecánico
steps.es: Déjemela media hora y le digo.
steps.en: Leave it with me half an hour and I will tell you.

options.es: Va pues. Aquí en la esquina lo espero.
options.en: Right then. I will wait for you on the corner here.
options.feedback: Accepted and you stayed nearby, which is what everybody does. Leaving entirely is how a half hour becomes Thursday.

options.en: All right, I will be back in a bit.
options.feedback: Fine. Ahorita from you is now the same word it is from him.

options.en: And how much is it going to cost me?
options.feedback: He has not looked at it yet. That question now says you expect to be cheated.

steps.speaker: Mecánico
steps.es: Era un tornillo suelto nada más. No le cobro.
steps.en: It was just a loose screw. I am not charging you.

options.es: Ideay, deje al menos le doy para un fresco.
options.en: Ideay, at least let me get you a cold drink.
options.feedback: Refusing to be given something free, once, is the polite move. He will take it or he will not.
Correct and enough. Offering something back is what turns him into your mechanic.
You took the free work and closed the door. He will remember the next time it is a real repair.
